standard_prerequisites.name: Flat and finite presentation ring maps are perfect, hence pseudo-coherent ring maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes relative pseudo-coherence over R moot.

standard_prerequisites.name: Over pseudo-coherent ring maps absolute and relative pseudo-coherence agree
Relative pseudo-coherence is transitive under composition, and A is pseudo-coherent relative to R
The definition of relative pseudo-coherence over a surjective ring map reduces to absolute pseudo-coherence of the restriction

core_obligations: Observe R -> A and R -> B are perfect ring maps by the flat-finite-presentation-perfect lemma, hence pseudo-coherent ring maps (proof lines 21901-21903).
By the relative-pseudo-coherent-is-moot lemma, (1) iff (2) and (4) iff (5) (proof lines 21904-21905).

Since A is pseudo-coherent relative to R, the composition lemma gives (2) iff (3); since B -> A is surjective, the definition of relative pseudo-coherence directly gives (3) iff (4) (proof lines 21908-21913).
proof_roadmap: Identify the ring maps as pseudo-coherent (proof lines 21901-21903).
Apply the mootness lemma for (1)(2)(4)(5) (proof lines 21904-21905).
Apply transitivity and the surjective definition for (2)(3)(4) (proof lines 21908-21913).
